notFound.title: Oops — This Page Has Gone Off-Script!

subtitle.dimension: This page wandered off into another dimension, and frankly it seems quite happy there with no intention of coming back.
subtitle.trainingArc: This page is on a training arc — it'll be back stronger, wiser, and with a brand-new power-up you never saw coming.
subtitle.plotTwist: Plot twist: this page doesn't exist. The real page was the friends we made along the way. Spoiler: they're gone too.
subtitle.houdini: Seems like this page pulled a Houdini on us. One moment it was here, the next — poof — gone without so much as a curtain call.
subtitle.void: This URL leads to the void. The void stares back. Then the void shrugs and goes back to watching anime. Classic void.
subtitle.kamehameha: Loading failed… maybe try a Kamehameha? If that doesn't work, a Rasengan, a Getsuga Tenshō, or just hitting Ctrl+R might do.
subtitle.timeline: Our server searched every timeline across the multiverse, consulted three oracles, and still found absolutely nothing here.
subtitle.questGone: Error 404: the page went on a quest and never returned. Rumour has it, it found a great anime recommendation and got sidetracked.
subtitle.uncharted: You've discovered uncharted territory. Plant a flag, name it after yourself, and enjoy the solitude — there's nothing else here.
subtitle.endOfInternet: You've reached the end of the internet. Just kidding. But this page is gone, probably binge-watching something in another tab.

edwardElric.name: Edward Elric

lelouch.name: Lelouch vi Britannia

mikasa.name: Mikasa Ackerman

tanjiro.name: Tanjiro Kamado
tanjiro.quote: With all my training, I still couldn't locate this page. I could smell it once, but the scent has vanished.

spike.name: Spike Spiegel
spike.quote: Whatever happens, happens. And apparently, what happened is this page disappeared. See you, Space Page.

light.name: Light Yagami
